verdict.rationale: Unleash documents its own metric-driven automation. Impact metrics let you automate milestone progression or trigger safeguards that pause rollouts or disable environments when metrics cross a threshold (e.g., pause when latency rises, progress only if error rates stay low). Release templates progress automatically while monitoring health, and scheduled changes add time-based triggers. This is narrow, though: rollout safeguards and schedules rather than a general rule engine. missing for 10: general-purpose event-to-action rules beyond rollout metrics and schedules, an arbitrary event-source catalog, configurable action types beyond pause/disable/progress, independent or hands-on corroboration.
